why: This file calls a model but never applies the SHA-256 boundary. Any diff, title, page or user text reaching the prompt raw is a prompt-injection path. Build the user content from wrapBoundary(...).
bad: const res = await client.messages.create({ model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `# Diff\n${input.diff}` }] });
good:
const content = `${TEMPLATE}\n${wrapBoundary(input.diff, 'executor diff')}`;
const res = await client.messages.create({ model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content }] });
